name: Royler
trait: Fastest horse in Pywel
summary: The white legendary horse with golden legs. It reaches the top Speed and Acceleration ratings, holds the deepest stamina pool of any mount on record, and is the one horse that learns Consecutive Instant Acceleration: a second boost out of every drift.

speed.basis: Speed 5 and Acceleration 5 at Lv 5, plus Consecutive Instant Acceleration — no other horse gets the second boost.

stamina.basis: 390 Stamina at Lv 5, the highest figure recorded for any mount.

travel.basis: Top speed on the longest stamina bar, with Water Sprint and Double Jump to cut corners.

combat.basis: 23 Attack at Lv 5. A horse only fights through its champron charge and back kick.

steps: Ride north from the City of Hernand into Pailune's Silverwolf Mountains.
Find the lake beside Snowgrass Hearth campsite, just under the “P” of “Pailune” on the world map. The route passes a Black Bear camp you can ride straight past.
Mount Royler and win the taming minigame: steer against the way it bucks until the bar fills. The cold here drains stamina faster.
Register it with any stable manager (Hernand Stable, north-west of Hernand Castle, is the closest).

location: Lakeshore beside Snowgrass Hearth campsite, Silverwolf Mountains, Pailune.
notes: Fail the minigame and it bolts. Leave the area and come back to respawn it.
Royler is reachable early: the lake sits just north of the starting city.

captures.caption: World map — under the “P” of Pailune
On site — the Snowgrass Hearth lakeshore

name: Rokade
trait: Toughest horse — highest Health
summary: The charcoal-black legendary horse of the Steel Mountains. It carries the most Health of any horse and tops the herd in Handling and Jump at max level, which makes it the safest horse to ride through a fight.

speed.basis: Speed 4 and Acceleration 4 at Lv 5 — one step under Royler and Camora.

travel.basis: Handling 5 and Jump 5 at Lv 5 (best of all horses) with Water Sprint.

combat.basis: 840 Health at Lv 5 — the hardest horse to knock out — but only 26 Attack.

steps: Head south-east of the City of Hernand into the Steel Mountains (Grace Estate).
Find the lake near the Spire of Insight; Rokade grazes on the grass around it.
Mount it and win the taming minigame. The climate here is mild, so stamina drains at the normal rate.
Register it with any stable manager.

location: Grassland around the lake near the Spire of Insight, Grace Estate, Steel Mountains.
notes: Farther from Hernand than Royler's lake, but easier to tame thanks to the mild weather.

captures.caption: World map — lake west of the Steel Mountains label
On site — Rokade by the lake

name: Camora
trait: Hardest-hitting horse — top Attack & Defense
summary: The blood-red legendary horse of the Redtree Forest. It has the highest Attack and Defense of any horse and reaches the same Speed rating as Royler at max level, without Royler's extra boost.

speed.basis: Speed 5 and Acceleration 5 at Lv 5, but no Consecutive Instant Acceleration.

travel.basis: Fast with Water Sprint and Double Jump; the long ride south is the only drawback.

combat.basis: 33 Attack and 120 Defense at Lv 5 — best of all horses, still below the beast mounts.

steps: Travel to the far south-east of Pywel: the Redtree Forest by the Red River, southern Crimson Desert (Tashkalp).
Camora roams the grass around the giant red tree with a herd of ordinary horses.
Mount it and win the taming minigame; the climate does not drain extra stamina.
Register it with any stable manager.

location: Grassland around the giant red tree, Redtree Forest, by the Red River.
notes: Look for the red bay coat among the herd — the other horses here are ordinary breeds.

captures.caption: World map — west of the Red River
On site — the herd in the red blossoms

name: Blackstar
trait: Fire-breathing flight over all of Pywel
summary: Kliff's dragon, earned at the close of Chapter 11. It flies anywhere on the continent and rains Fireball and Fire Breath on camps from above — rationed by a real-time timer.

speed.basis: True flight with dive-bomb acceleration; nothing in the sky outpaces it.

stamina.basis: About 15 real-time minutes per summon, then roughly 50 minutes of cooldown.

travel.basis: Crosses any terrain on the map in a straight line.

combat.basis: 2,500 Health, Fireball and Fire Breath from the air — built for clearing whole camps.

steps: Meet and cleanse the wounded Blackstar at the Palace of Urdavah during Chapter 9 (The Sage of the Desert).
Push on to the Chapter 11 finale and bring down the Golden Star; White Crow then hands you control of the dragon.
Summon it from the mount wheel in open outdoor space. It cannot be called inside the Abyss.

location: Story unlock — no world location.
notes: Active for about 15 real-time minutes per summon, followed by roughly 50 minutes of real-time cooldown. Resting does not shorten it.
The Enhanced update (2.0) added camera-based and manual flight control options.

sources.title: How to Unlock the Dragon — Game8

name: Silver Fang
trait: Keeps fighting after you dismount
summary: The pale legendary wolf at the end of House Celeste's Legendary Wolf questline. Slow and short-winded under a rider, it keeps fighting on its own after you step down.

stamina.basis: 100 Stamina — the lowest recorded for a permanent mount.

travel.basis: Slow with a tiny stamina bar; a fighting mount, not a traveller.

combat.basis: 100 Attack and an aggressive AI that fights alongside you on foot.

requires: House Celeste, Vellua Fishermen's Guild and Parish of Solumen questlines

steps: Finish the prerequisite faction questlines to open House Celeste's Legendary Wolf chain (starts with Silence from Afar).
Defeat Black Fang in that chain. It drops Leebur's Soul, which marks every legendary animal on your map.
Hunt Silver Fang at Howling Hollow near Sage's Peak, northern Hernand, then skin it for the Fang of Silver Fang.
At any Witch: Craft Abyss Gear → Special Items → Sigil of Solidarity. Use the sigil to register the mount.

location: Howling Hollow, near Sage's Peak, northern Hernand.
notes: Lightning briefly stuns it.
The purple flowers in the hollow hurt you while you stand on them.
Summon it from the mount wheel, where your horse normally sits.

captures.caption: World map — Howling Hollow (inset)
On site — the hollow from above

name: White Bear
trait: Highest base damage of any mount
summary: A legendary bear of the Pailune peaks. 1,500 Health and 180 Attack make it the heaviest hitter you can ride: its swipes shred crowds, and it keeps fighting when you dismount.

speed.basis: Very slow next to any horse (Game8).

travel.basis: Slow and short-ranged; summon it for fights, not journeys.

combat.basis: 1,500 Health and 180 Attack — the top damage figure on record — plus crowd-clearing swipes.

steps: Go to Five-Finger Mountain, east of Silver Wolf Mountain in Pailune.
Defeat the White Bear. Fire sends it rolling on the ground, opening a free damage window.
Skin it for the White Bear Claws.
Craft the Sigil of Solidarity at any Witch (Craft Abyss Gear → Special Items) and use it to register the bear.

location: Five-Finger Mountain, east of Silver Wolf Mountain, Pailune.
notes: Skinning can also yield the White Bear Helm.
Clawed Bears list the same 1,500 / 180 statline on Fextralife.

captures.caption: World map — Five-Finger Mountain (inset)
On site — the snowfield

name: Snowwhite Deer
trait: Top stamina of the beast legendaries
summary: A mist-born legendary deer of Silverwolf Mountain. It arrives at full strength — 300 Stamina and near-legendary-horse pace — with no levelling, but it learns no mount skills.

speed.basis: “Quite fast” — nearly a match for the legendary horses over distance (Game8, Fextralife).

stamina.basis: 300 Stamina, highest of the beast legendaries. Royler (315 at Lv 1, 390 at Lv 5) still leads overall.

travel.basis: The best non-horse land traveller; no skills, but no levelling needed either.

steps: Go to Silverwolf Mountain in Pailune, by the letter “A” of “Pailune” on the world map.
Defeat the Snowwhite Deer. It is weak to fire and easily stun-locked by heavy hits; a charged fire arrow from range stops it bolting.
Skin it for the Snowwhite Deer Antlers.
Craft the Sigil of Solidarity at any Witch and use it to register the deer.

location: Silverwolf Mountain, Pailune — beside the “A” of the region label.
notes: Skinning may also yield the Throne of the White Knight for your house.

captures.caption: World map — by the “A” of Pailune
On site — the mountain slope

name: Icicle Edge Alpine Ibex
trait: Best jumper of the beast legendaries
summary: Moren the Mistwood Huntmaster's white alpine ibex. Strong stamina, decent speed and the highest Jump rating recorded for a beast — made for Pailune's cliffs.

travel.basis: Jump 5 and sure footing on rough mountain ground.

combat.basis: 25 Attack; it can kick backwards but is no fighter.

requires: Longleaf Tribe faction quests up to The Sport Hunter

steps: Progress the Longleaf Tribe faction questline to The Sport Hunter.
Track Moren with your lantern near the Wayward Woods, west Pailune (north of the Ridge Hunter Tannery). He rides the ibex with an escort.
Beat him twice — he vanishes into the fog after his first health bar — to earn the Icicle Edge Alpine Ibex Horns.
Craft the Sigil of Solidarity at any Witch and use it to register the ibex.

location: Wayward Woods, west Pailune — north of the Ridge Hunter Tannery.
notes: Clear Moren's escort first; the two-phase fight gets messy in the fog.

captures.caption: World map — Moren's hunting ground

sources.title: Icicle Edge Alpine Ibex — Fextralife Wiki

name: Rock Tusk Warthog
trait: Charges through shield lines
summary: Ravok of the Savage Fangs' armoured war-boar. Slower than any horse, but its charge tramples groups and breaks shield walls.

travel.basis: Slow; fine across swamp and brush, poor over distance.

combat.basis: 100 Attack and a trampling charge that breaks shield formations.

steps: Head to the Red River in southern Tashkalp, Crimson Desert, and use your lantern to track Ravok of the Savage Fangs.
Defeat him twice — he escapes after his first health bar — to trigger a cutscene and earn the Rock Tusk Warthog Molar.
Craft the Sigil of Solidarity at any Witch and use it to register the warthog.

location: Near the Red River, southern Tashkalp, Crimson Desert.
notes: Ravok rides with a large escort; thin it out before engaging.

captures.caption: World map — Ravok's patrol area
On site — Ravok and his riders

name: Ocean Drifter
trait: Fastest underwater mount
summary: An ancient diving machine sealed in the Forgotten Ocean Ruins. It outruns every sea creature — and your ship — below the surface, but it only works submerged and punishes surfacing with an hour-long lockout.

speed.basis: The fastest underwater mount, faster than your ship (Game8, GameRant).

stamina.basis: “Exceptional stamina” (GameRant); Ascend trades stamina for a burst.

travel.basis: Unmatched for crossing deep water — mind the 60-minute cooldown.

steps: Sail to Razanui Island in the south-west sea and mark the water north-west of it.
Dive about 55 m to the Forgotten Ocean Ruins and enter through the north-facing door.
Swim up through the ceiling gaps to the top floor and open the chest for the Ancients' Chest.
Use the Ancients' Chest from your inventory (Key Items). The Ocean Drifter registers instantly.

location: Forgotten Ocean Ruins, ~55 m down, north-west of Razanui Island.
notes: Works only underwater, from roughly 30 m down.
Surfacing or summoning another mount despawns it and starts a 60-minute real-time cooldown — fast travel away from it and you wait an hour.
Ascend: rise or swim faster, paid for in stamina.

captures.caption: World map — dive point north-west of Razanui
World map — the wider south-west sea
On site — inside the ruins

name: Golden Shark
trait: Apex of the deep — speed and a vicious bite
summary: The gold-skinned legendary shark patrolling the deep water south of Dewhaven. Fast, enduring and armed with a violent bite.

travel.basis: A strong all-round sea mount with no cooldown penalty.

combat.basis: The legendary shark bite; the strongest fighter among sea creatures.

steps: Sail south of Dewhaven (Delesyia), directly east of the Sea Serpent Kelp Forest.
Dive to roughly 220 m. The Golden Shark circles nearby and may attack first.
Stun it with Force Palm to the head, mount it, and win the taming minigame: push up and away from the tail.
It registers as a permanent mount.

location: ~220 m down, east of the Sea Serpent Kelp Forest, south of Dewhaven.
notes: Game8 also reports it south of Stoneward Harbor.

captures.caption: World map — east of the Sea Serpent Kelp Forest
World map — close-up of the dive point
On site — the shark at depth

name: Pink Dolphin
trait: Sonar that pings hidden loot
summary: A rare pink dolphin leading a pod over the Great Coral Reef. It cannot attack, but its Underwater Detection scans the seabed for loot.

speed.basis: No comparative speed data — rated average.

stamina.basis: No comparative stamina data — rated average.

travel.basis: A utility mount: detection over speed.

combat.basis: No attack; you have to defend it.

steps: Sail to the Great Coral Reef in the far south-west, just above the “E” of “Great” on the map.
Dive to about 60 m to find the dolphin pod. It is dark down there — mount dolphins one by one until you land on the pink one.
Feed it three Fish Fillets from your inventory to hit 100 Trust, then register it.

location: ~60 m down over the Great Coral Reef, above the “E” of “Great”.
notes: Underwater Detection: LB + RB / L2 + R2.
Sharks spawn constantly here and can kill a dolphin in one hit — keep the Harpoon Gun ready.

captures.caption: World map — above the “E” of Great Coral Reef
World map — the wider south-west sea

name: Pink Manta Ray
area: North of the Dead Coral Sea
trait: Shockwave that stuns everything around you
summary: A legendary pink manta gliding with its school north of the Dead Coral Sea. Its area shockwave stuns sharks and other hostiles around you.

speed.basis: No comparative speed data — rated average.

stamina.basis: No comparative stamina data — rated average.

travel.basis: Average traveller with a strong defensive tool.

combat.basis: Area-of-effect Shockwave that stuns nearby creatures.

steps: Sail far east of Delesyia to the water north of the Dead Coral Sea — line the marker up between the second “D” of “Dead Coral Sea” and the tip of the “A” in “Delesyia”.
Dive straight down to about 130 m to find it with its school.
Swim up, mount it, and feed Fish Fillets until Trust hits 100, then register it.

location: ~130 m down, north of the Dead Coral Sea, far east of Delesyia.
notes: Shockwave: RT / R2.

captures.caption: World map — close-up of the dive point
World map — Delesyia and the East Sea
On site — the school at 130 m

name: Leaping Kuku Bird
trait: No fall damage — glides down from any height
summary: A flightless crimson bird that leaps higher than a man and glides down safely from any drop. Since patch 1.10 the egg hatches into a Kuku Bird Chick pet that you raise into the mount.

speed.basis: No comparative speed data — rated average.

stamina.basis: No verified stamina figure — rated average.

travel.basis: Trait override: high leaps and no fall damage turn cliffs into shortcuts.

combat.basis: No combat moves; a pure traversal mount.

routes.label: Get the egg
steps: Bloodsteel Camp, southern Demeniss: clear or slip past the Blinding Arrow garrison and find the tall wooden tower beside the makeshift throne.
Climb to the panel wall just under the roof, cling with Resist (Q / LT / L2) and hit it with Force Palm to rotate it open.
Mask on, take the Kuku Bird's Egg — and the Leaping Kuku Bird Research Journal on the table — then wait inside until the theft cools off.

routes.label: Hatch and raise it
steps: Carry the egg to the nest beside a tree in the forest between Kingshield Dig Site and Grey Rock Quarry, north of the “D” in “Demeniss”. Use the egg from your inventory to place it; it pulses orange when seated.
Wait about five minutes until it glows bright orange, then interact to hatch a Kuku Bird Chick (it registers as a pet).
Keep the chick out and drop fruit and vegetables for it. Rest a day and feed again until it reaches growth level 3.
Interact with the chick and choose Grow — it becomes the Leaping Kuku Bird mount.

location: Egg: tower room, Bloodsteel Camp (southern Demeniss). Nest: forest between Kingshield Dig Site and Grey Rock Quarry.
notes: Before patch 1.10 the egg hatched straight into an adult mount; guides written before June 2026 skip the chick stage.
Want both the pet and the mount? Hatch two eggs.
Kuku Bird Saddle (+20 Defense): Driana at Calphade Saddlery or Fiona at Demeniss Saddlery, 28 Silver.

captures.caption: Egg — Bloodsteel Camp on the world map
Egg — the trick-wall tower
Nest — close-up on the world map
Nest — north of the “D” in Demeniss

sources.title: Kuku Bird Chick & Leaping Kuku Bird — Vulkk

name: Giant Red Iguana
trait: Long-range spit that staggers enemies
summary: The Goldenscale Bandits' red desert lizard. Built for hot sand, armed with a long-range spit that staggers enemies — but fragile once the arrows fly.

speed.basis: Moves swiftly over dunes and rock; no comparative figure — rated average.

stamina.basis: No verified stamina figure — rated average. Every spit costs stamina.

travel.basis: Stable on hot sand; ordinary elsewhere.

combat.basis: Ranged stagger-spit, but low durability gets you knocked off.

steps: Find the Goldenscale Bandits waiting on the road south of Tommaso, near the Sovereign Wastes Abyss Nexus (Crimson Desert).
Knock a rider off their iguana. The freed iguana turns hostile — stun it with Force Palm until Ride appears.
Ride it and feed raw vegetables (a Golden Apple gives +100 Trust).
When Trust reaches 100, press Take In (Y / Triangle) to register it as a permanent special mount.

location: Road south of Tommaso, near the Sovereign Wastes Abyss Nexus.
notes: Do not dismount before Take In — it turns hostile again.
Giant Iguana Saddle: Alina, Tommaso Saddlery. Fits both colours.

captures.caption: World map — Goldenscale Bandits' road

name: Giant Green Iguana
trait: Steal-and-ride desert lizard
summary: The tame green iguana kept in the City of Tommaso. Same sand-running build and spit attack as the red variant — this one has to be stolen.

speed.basis: Moves swiftly over dunes and rock; rated average.

stamina.basis: No verified stamina figure — rated average.

travel.basis: Stable on hot sand; ordinary elsewhere.

steps: Go to the easternmost part of the City of Tommaso, Tashkalp (Crimson Desert).
Mask on, steal the iguana, and ride out of the red circle to dodge the bounty.
Feed raw vegetables (Golden Apple +100).
When Trust reaches 100, press Take In (Y / Triangle) to register it as a permanent special mount.

location: Eastern edge of the City of Tommaso, Tashkalp.
notes: Giant Iguana Saddle: Alina, Tommaso Saddlery.

captures.caption: World map — Tommaso, Tashkalp
On site — the iguana in Tommaso

name: Red-Feathered Raptor
trait: Twilight Messenger war-runner
summary: An iguana-faced runner crowned with a fan of feathers, ridden by Twilight Messenger soldiers in the Crimson Desert.

speed.basis: No comparative speed data — rated average.

stamina.basis: No verified stamina figure — rated average.

travel.basis: Average all-rounder.

steps: Ride to the Crimson Mountains Fortress, east of the City of Tommaso. A mounted Twilight Messenger patrols the Crimson Mountains Watchtower east of the fort.
Knock him off. The raptor bolts — chase it down and mount it.
Feed any raw meat (+40 Trust each; about three pieces).
When Trust reaches 100, press Take In (Y / Triangle) to register it as a permanent special mount.

location: Crimson Mountains Watchtower, east of the Crimson Mountains Fortress.

captures.caption: World map — the watchtower patrol

name: Lion
trait: Heavy single-target lunge
summary: Pywel's endangered big cat. Its lunge hits hard but lands on one target at a time.

travel.basis: A fighting mount.

combat.basis: 450 Health, 100 Attack and a heavy lunge.

routes.label: Circus Lion
steps: Go to the Laughing Marionette circus just east of the City of Demeniss. The lion waits outside the tent near a rhino and a hippo.
Mask on, steal it, and ride out of the red circle.
Feed raw meat. When Trust reaches 100, press Take In (Y / Triangle) to register it as a permanent special mount.

routes.label: Wild Lion
steps: Hunt and skin the Legendary White Lion, north-east of the Varnia Gate (Crimson Desert).
Reset the area (fast travel, or wait 12 in-game hours). A male Lion returns with lionesses.
Defeat the lionesses, Force Palm the Lion until Ride appears, then feed raw meat. When Trust reaches 100, press Take In (Y / Triangle) to register it as a permanent special mount.

location: Laughing Marionette circus (Demeniss) · north-east of the Varnia Gate (Crimson Desert).
notes: Only male lions can be ridden.
The circus lion sometimes fails to appear even after a reset.

captures.caption: Circus Lion — the Laughing Marionette, Demeniss
Wild Lion — north-east of the Varnia Gate

name: Tiger
trait: One spawn — gone if the White Tiger dies
summary: Tigers appear only as guardians of the Legendary White Tiger at a single lake in the southern Crimson Desert. Tame one before the White Tiger falls.

travel.basis: A fighting mount.

combat.basis: 450 Health, 100 Attack, explosive pounces; keeps fighting on foot.

steps: Go to the unnamed lake beside Giant's Yard Watchtower on the Crimson Desert's southern peninsula — north of Beardtree Gorge, south-west of the Red River.
Damage a Tiger until it collapses and Ride appears.
Feed it (Fextralife lists Chewy Rice Cake dishes as its favourites).
When Trust reaches 100, press Take In (Y / Triangle) to register it as a permanent special mount.

location: Lake beside Giant's Yard Watchtower, southern peninsula of the Crimson Desert.
notes: If the White Tiger is already dead, neither it nor its Tigers respawn — only an earlier save helps.
A downed Tiger mount comes back after about five real minutes.

captures.caption: World map — the lake by Giant's Yard Watchtower

name: Brown Bear
region: All regions except the Crimson Desert
area: Fields north-west of the Sanctum of Penitence
trait: Crowd-clearing swipes, found almost anywhere
summary: Pywel's apex predator, roaming every region except the Crimson Desert. Its swiping attacks clear groups of weaker enemies.

travel.basis: Slow and heavy.

combat.basis: 1,000 Health and 120 Attack with wide swipes.

steps: Find a wild bear. The open fields north-west of the Sanctum of Penitence are a reliable spot.
Damage it or use Force Palm until it stops moving and Ride appears.
Feed it (Fextralife lists Garlic among its favourites).
When Trust reaches 100, press Take In (Y / Triangle) to register it as a permanent special mount.

location: Wild across Pywel except the Crimson Desert; fields north-west of the Sanctum of Penitence.
notes: Grizzly and Captured Bear variants share the bear moveset.

name: Clawed Bear
trait: Black Bear war-mount — gone after Chapter 7
summary: The armoured black war-bear of the Black Bear soldiers in Pailune. Its listed statline matches the legendary White Bear — but it is only available while the Black Bears hold the region.

travel.basis: Slow and heavy.

combat.basis: Listed at 1,500 Health / 180 Attack, the White Bear's statline (Fextralife; unconfirmed in-game).

steps: Find Black Bear soldiers riding Clawed Bears in Pailune's forts and camps.
Knock the rider off and subdue the bear until Ride appears.
Feed it (Garlic is a favourite).
When Trust reaches 100, press Take In (Y / Triangle) to register it as a permanent special mount.

location: Black Bear forts and camps, Pailune.
notes: After Chapter 7 the Black Bears leave Pailune and these bears go with them. Tame one first.

name: Large Wolf
trait: Pack hunter in 16 coats
summary: Pywel's pack hunters. Large Wolf, Swift Wolf and Large White Wolf share one kit: no mount skills, dependable in a fight.

travel.basis: A fighting mount.

steps: Find wolves in the wild — they range widely and favour the western mountains.
Damage one until it collapses and Ride appears.
Feed grilled meat (Satisfying Grilled Meat is a top pick).
When Trust reaches 100, press Take In (Y / Triangle) to register it as a permanent special mount.

location: Wilds across most of Pywel; most common in the western mountains.
notes: Wolf saddles: Annabella (Hernand Saddlery) and Bruna (Equinsher Saddlery).

name: Rosehorn Deer
trait: Clears high walls, sure-footed on ledges
summary: A forest deer with great branching antlers, known for leaping high walls and running steadily along narrow mountain paths.

speed.basis: No comparative speed data — rated average.

stamina.basis: Described with “exceptional endurance”; no verified figure.

travel.basis: Leaps and narrow-path footing help in the mountains.

steps: Find Mistwood Hunters riding Rosehorn Deer in Pailune.
Knock a rider off and mount the deer.
Feed raw vegetables (Golden Apple +100).
When Trust reaches 100, press Take In (Y / Triangle) to register it as a permanent special mount.

location: Ridden by Mistwood Hunters, Pailune.
notes: Deer saddles: Bruna (Equinsher Saddlery) and Fiona (Demeniss Saddlery).

name: Ibex
trait: Cliff-climber of the high pastures
summary: Pailune's noble mountain goat. Muscular legs and hooves carry it up steep cliffs and frozen rock.

travel.basis: Slow, but climbs where horses cannot.

steps: Find ibex wandering Pailune's mountain areas.
Mount one and feed raw vegetables (Golden Apple +100).
When Trust reaches 100, press Take In (Y / Triangle) to register it as a permanent special mount.

location: Mountain areas of Pailune.

name: Sandwalk Camel
trait: Quest reward that never sinks in the dunes
summary: A single-humped desert camel with broad hooves that keep it from sinking into soft dunes. It comes free with the Redwind Merchant Guild questline.

speed.basis: No comparative speed data — rated average.

stamina.basis: No verified stamina figure — rated average.

travel.basis: Steady on soft sand.

steps: Start at Saltroad Hearth, north-east of the Great Gate of Urdavah: a dying man calls for help beside a plundered wagon.
Follow the questline and defeat Gristle, the Sandfang Marauder.
Report to the head merchant at The Pilgrim's Oasis. He hands over the Sandwalk Camel.

location: Quest start: Saltroad Hearth, north-east of the Great Gate of Urdavah.
notes: Also rewards the Seal of Greed: +20% trade-goods profit for 2 hours.
Finished the questline before patch 1.06? The camel was added to your stable automatically.
Camel Saddles: Varnia saddlery.

captures.caption: World map — Saltroad Hearth quest start
On site — the plundered wagon

name: Savage Fang Boar
trait: The raiders' everyday war-boar
summary: The common war-boar of the Savage Fangs raiders — the everyday version of Ravok's legendary mount.

stamina.basis: No verified figure — rated with the legendary warthog's 200.

travel.basis: A fighting mount.

combat.basis: Charging tusks; below Ravok's legendary warthog.

steps: Find Savage Fangs riders in Tashkalp and the Crimson Desert.
Knock a rider off their warthog and subdue it until Ride appears.
Feed raw meat.
When Trust reaches 100, press Take In (Y / Triangle) to register it as a permanent special mount.

location: Ridden by Savage Fangs raiders, Tashkalp and the Crimson Desert.

name: Wyvern
trait: A flier you raise yourself
summary: Since patch 1.10 a Baby Wyvern pet grows into a saddle-ready adult — a flying mount you raise from the egg. Wild adults at Fort Windridge can only be ridden temporarily.

speed.basis: True flight; Blackstar remains the faster flier.

travel.basis: Flies over any terrain.

steps: Hatch a Baby Wyvern from the egg at Wyvern's Cradle in Delesyia (Pororin questline).
Keep it out as your pet and drop meat for it daily until it reaches growth level 3.
Use Grow, then register it as a special mount. The Wyvern Saddle arrived with the same patch.

location: Egg: Wyvern's Cradle, Delesyia. Wild adults: Fort Windridge, Delesyia (temporary rides).
notes: Wild Wyverns at Fort Windridge can be subdued and ridden but not kept.

sources.title: Kuku Bird Chick & Baby Wyvern — Gfinity

name: Shark
trait: Fast, aggressive, common
summary: The everyday predator of the new ocean. Fast and aggressive — you subdue it rather than feed it.

speed.basis: “Very fast” for a common mount; below the Hammerhead and the legendaries.

travel.basis: A solid early sea mount.

steps: Search coastal water around the new islands. Red Hangs Island, by the lone Abyss Cresset on Delesyia's outskirts, is reliable.
Aggro a shark and wear it down with the Harpoon Gun without killing it.
Force Palm its snout as it charges, mount it, and win the taming minigame.

location: Coastal water around the new islands; Red Hangs Island is reliable.
notes: The taming minigame drains stamina fast — bring stamina and heals, and tame by daylight.

captures.caption: World map — Red Hangs Island Abyss Cresset

sources.title: How to Tame the Shark — PowerUp Gaming

name: Hammerhead Shark
area: Trench north of the Great Coral Reef
trait: Much faster than a normal shark
summary: The far-water cousin of the common shark, found in the South Sea trench. Same taming routine, notably more speed.

speed.basis: “Notably much faster than a normal Shark” (Game8).

travel.basis: The fastest non-legendary sea mount on record.

steps: Go to the South Sea — the trench north of the Great Coral Reef.
Knock it out with Force Palm, mount it and win the taming minigame.

location: Trench north of the Great Coral Reef, South Sea.

name: Orca
trait: Shark-class brawler, rarer spawn
summary: Rarer than sharks and found in the same waters — best hunted around the Great Rocky Reef and far from the mainland.

travel.basis: An alternative to the shark.

combat.basis: A large predator tamed by force, like the shark.

steps: Search the Great Rocky Reef and other waters far from the mainland.
Force Palm it, mount it and win the taming minigame.

location: Great Rocky Reef and waters far from the mainland.
notes: The Great Rocky Reef is also home to a Megalodon boss — keep your distance while hunting.

name: Sea Turtle
trait: Common but skittish — approach fast or unseen
summary: Plentiful across the ocean but hard to catch: it bolts unless you close in fast or stay unseen.

travel.basis: A defensive mount, not a racer.

combat.basis: Its ride ability is defensive rather than offensive (Mobalytics).

steps: Find one anywhere in the ocean.
Approach with high swim speed or stealth so it does not startle, then mount it.
Feed Seaweed Clusters or Jellyfish Fillets until Trust reaches 100, then register it.

location: Common across the ocean.

name: Sunfish
trait: Extends your dive
summary: A huge, gentle sunfish whose ride ability lets you stay down longer.

travel.basis: Dive extension makes long dives practical.

steps: Find a sunfish in open water.
Ride it and feed Fish Fillet until Trust reaches 100, then register it.

location: Open ocean (no fixed spawn documented).

name: Dolphin
trait: Friendly — no Force Palm needed
summary: A neutral mount: swim up, climb on and feed it. Pods gather over the Great Coral Reef.

travel.basis: The easiest sea mount to get.

steps: Approach a dolphin in the water and ride it.
Feed any seafood until Trust reaches 100, then register it.

location: Pods over the Great Coral Reef.
notes: Sharks hunt these pods and can kill a dolphin in one hit.

name: Manta Ray
trait: Glides near the reef surface
summary: Plentiful near the surface of the Great Coral Reef. A neutral mount: no fight, just food.

travel.basis: Average sea traveller.

steps: Find manta rays gliding near the surface of the Great Coral Reef.
Swim up, ride one and feed Fish Fillet or Golden Coral until Trust reaches 100, then register it.

location: Near the surface of the Great Coral Reef.

name: Eagle Ray
trait: Spotted ray, tamed with fillets
summary: A spotted ray tamed the gentle way — ride it and feed it.

travel.basis: Average sea traveller.

steps: Find an eagle ray in open water.
Ride it and feed Fish Fillet until Trust reaches 100, then register it.

location: Open ocean (no fixed spawn documented).

name: Electric Ray
trait: Glowing ray of the dark depths
summary: A dark-water ray with a glowing body, tamed with fillets like the other rays.

travel.basis: Average sea traveller.

steps: Find an electric ray in deeper, darker water.
Ride it and feed Fish Fillet until Trust reaches 100, then register it.

location: Open ocean (no fixed spawn documented).

name: Spotted Seal
trait: Chase it into the water to ride
summary: Basks on the seashore west of Iliya Island. Herd it into the water and it becomes rideable.

travel.basis: Average sea traveller.

steps: Find spotted seals along the shore west of Iliya Island.
Chase one into the water — you can only mount it there.
Feed any seafood until Trust reaches 100, then register it.

location: Seashores west of Iliya Island.

name: Herspia
trait: Kliff's first horse — no weak spot, no standout
summary: Kliff's starting breed. Sensitive and easily startled, but loyal and quick to settle. Even 3s across the board at max level.

travel.basis: Average across the board.

routes.label: Story
steps: Given during the main quest Unknown Space, right after the prologue.

routes.label: Other ways
steps: Tame one in the wild, buy one where a stable has it in stock, or steal one from an NPC (Mask on, then ride out of the red circle).

location: Wild herds across Pywel; some stables stock them; ridden by NPCs.
notes: Your story Herspia has usually out-levelled any fresh horse by mid-game.

captures.caption: Story — the ride in Unknown Space
Stable — the Buy Horse screen

name: Priden
trait: Best vertical horse — learns High Jump
summary: A calm, distinctively marked breed that nobles give their children. It levels into the best jumping kit among ordinary horses.

travel.basis: High Jump plus Double Jump open shortcuts.

steps: Tame one in the wild, buy one where a stable has it in stock, or steal one from an NPC (Mask on, then ride out of the red circle).

location: Wild herds across Pywel; some stables stock them; ridden by NPCs.

captures.caption: Stable — the Buy Horse screen

name: Brianto
trait: Fast but fragile — two boosts per drift
summary: Damiane's default breed. Lowest Health and Stamina of the horses, but it levels into Speed 4 and learns both boost skills.

speed.basis: Speed 4 at Lv 5 with Instant Acceleration and Consecutive Instant Acceleration.

travel.basis: Quick, but the stamina bar cuts runs short.

combat.basis: Lowest Health of any horse (420 at Lv 5).

routes.label: Story
steps: Damiane's default mount when she joins in Chapter 3.

routes.label: Other ways
steps: Tame one in the wild, buy one where a stable has it in stock, or steal one from an NPC (Mask on, then ride out of the red circle).

location: Wild herds across Pywel; some stables stock them; ridden by NPCs.
notes: Royler beats it on every stat; Brianto is the budget speed pick.

captures.caption: Stable — the Buy Horse screen

name: Elantrima
trait: Hauler — extra inventory slot, top Health
summary: A parade breed with feathered legs and striking coats. Highest Health of the ordinary horses, strong stamina and handling, and an extra inventory slot.

stamina.basis: 330 Stamina at Lv 5 — second only to Royler.

travel.basis: Steady, with Lateral Movement for control.

steps: Tame one in the wild, buy one where a stable has it in stock, or steal one from an NPC (Mask on, then ride out of the red circle).

location: Wild herds across Pywel; some stables stock them; ridden by NPCs.
notes: Nobles chase the rare coats.
variants: Black with White Mane and Blaze

captures.caption: Stable — the Buy Horse screen

name: Numont
trait: Officer's warhorse — quickest off the mark
summary: A heavy-framed officer's breed with big lungs. It reaches Acceleration 4 and learns a champron charge early.

travel.basis: Average.

combat.basis: 26 Attack and a Lv 3 Charge — best of the stable breeds.

steps: Tame one in the wild, buy one where a stable has it in stock, or steal one from an NPC (Mask on, then ride out of the red circle).

location: Wild herds across Pywel; some stables stock them; ridden by NPCs.

captures.caption: Stable — the Buy Horse screen

name: Cloudcart
trait: Craftable balloon for cross-continent hops
summary: The village's first flying prototype — a hot-air balloon built through your Greymane camp for long hops across the continent. Two upgraded hulls follow it.

speed.basis: A balloon: steady rather than fast.

travel.basis: Long-distance flight with no ground obstacles.

routes.label: Blueprint
steps: Unlock Dispatch Missions with the Chapter 3 quest Bustling Hill.
Glenbright Manor (Hernand Highlands, south of Howling Hill): open the 2nd-floor wardrobe and turn the wheel to light the statue.
Take the Sapphire-Set and Ruby-Set Golden Daggers, then push the wall with the jousting-knights painting downstairs for the Basement Key.
Slot both daggers above the office fireplace; the bookcase opens. Climb down and take the Cloudcart Blueprint.

routes.label: Build
steps: Discover Emberwind Workshop, north of Glenbright Manor, to unlock its dispatch mission.
Send the Cloudcart mission with an Engineer comrade. The Cloudcart joins your mounts.

location: Blueprint: Glenbright Manor basement. Workshop: Emberwind Workshop, north of the manor.
notes: Cloudcruiser (stronger fabric, higher altitude) and Skystreaker (high-altitude flagship) are built through further dispatch missions — reported at five Greymanes including an Engineer, plus a fresh batch of materials.
No Engineer yet? The quest A Rumor in St. Halssius recruits Arnold.

captures.caption: World map — Emberwind Workshop
On site — Emberwind Workshop
World map — Glenbright Manor

name: A.T.A.G.
trait: The tank of all mounts — dives with DLC parts
summary: All-Terrain Armored Gear: a walking mech with heavy armour and real punch. The Charting the Unknown DLC adds marine parts that turn it into a submarine.

travel.basis: All-terrain, and underwater once refitted.

combat.basis: “The tank of all mounts” — strong attacks and defence (Destructoid).

routes.label: Unlock
steps: Chapter 10 lends you an A.T.A.G. during the mecha siege.
In Chapter 11, accept the faction quest New Designs and speak with the artisan Marek at Zargan Tankworks, west Gorthak.
He gives the Small Kuku A.T.A.G. Design — the full blueprint. Craft it to keep the A.T.A.G. permanently.

routes.label: Underwater (DLC)
steps: Find the three Ancient Marine Exploration blueprints (Plate, Pack, Footwear) inside underwater temples.

Dispatch two members, one a Skilled Engineer, for each part at Delesyia's research bases (Plating: Marni's Masterium; Pack: Aeronautical Research Base). Each part costs a Natural Pearl plus hides or Manganese, 16k Camp Weapons, 9k Provisions and 100k Funds.
Equip the three parts to take the A.T.A.G. underwater.

location: Blueprint: Marek, Zargan Tankworks (west Gorthak).
notes: Game8 calls the refitted A.T.A.G. the ideal choice for underwater combat.

sources.title: How to Use the A.T.A.G. Underwater — Game8

name: Pywel Wagon
trait: A trading wagon for your camp
summary: A horse-drawn trading wagon built through the Greymane camp — slow, but it carries goods.

travel.basis: Roads only, slowly.

steps: Unlock Dispatch Missions with the Chapter 3 quest Bustling Hill.
Recruit Brice the Wagonmaster through A Rumor at Glenbright Farm (Embers of Return).
After the first four Greymane Commissions, take Brice's Request and talk to the Stranger by the wagon wheels at Timberturner Wainwright, east of Howling Hill.
Dispatch Old Wagon Production with an Engineering comrade: 120 Timber, 60 Food, 900 Silver.

location: Timberturner Wainwright, east of Howling Hill, Hernand.
notes: Bigger wagons can be crafted for more resources, workers and time.
Wagons can also be stolen from NPCs as temporary rides.

captures.caption: World map — Howling Hill to Timberturner Wainwright
Dispatch — Old Wagon Production

name: Kuku Bird Hatchling
trait: Temporary glider — steal one for a cliff
summary: Young kuku birds ridden by Blinding Arrow soldiers. They glide down any drop without fall damage, but you cannot keep one.

speed.basis: Flees fast; average under a rider.

travel.basis: Trait override: no fall damage from any height.

steps: Steel Mountains, east of the Spire of Insight: Blinding Arrow soldiers ride hatchlings.
Defeat a rider, then sprint after the bird before it escapes and mount it.

location: Blinding Arrow occupation, Steel Mountains, east of the Spire of Insight.
notes: Cannot be registered. For a permanent bird, see the Leaping Kuku Bird.
Step off and it wanders nearby; re-mount without another chase.

captures.caption: World map — Blinding Soldier occupation

sources.title: Kuku Bird Hatchling — The Games Wiki

name: Elephant
trait: Ride the giants of the wildlife park
summary: The wildlife park's elephants carry riders on request. Walk up and climb on — they stay behind when you leave.

travel.basis: Park grounds only.

steps: Go to Demeniss Wildlife Park, south of the City of Demeniss.
Approach an elephant and ride it.

location: Demeniss Wildlife Park, south of the City of Demeniss.
notes: Temporary only.
